Rolling Advertisement for Engagement of Research Staff under ICSSR Sponsored Project
Applications are invited in the prescribed format from the suitable eligible candidates for the engagement of research staff on a
part-time basis for the following research positions under a purely time-bound ICSSR Research Project titled “Urban
Governance in Jammu and Kashmir: An Evaluative Study of Smart Cities Mission in Jammu and Srinagar”, under the
Scheme Major and Minor Research Projects (2025-26) undertaken in the Department of Public Policy and Public Administration,
Central University of Jammu, Rahya-Suchani (Bagla), Samba–181143 (Jammu and Kashmir).
The details of the posts are as follows:

Terms and conditions:
 This temporary engagement will be for a specific period and services of research staff engaged on part-time basis will
automatically stand terminated either with the termination of the project/scheme or even before at the discretion of the
Project Co-ordinator and Director.
 The engagement will not entitle them any claim for regular employment in the University.
 Shortlisted candidates will be called for physical interview and they will be informed through email.
 The candidates called for interview are not entitled for TA/DA.
 The decision of selection committee will be final.
 Tenure of the assignment for the post at S. N. 1 shall initially be for a period of 02 months and may be extended for a further
01 months.
 Tenure of the assignment for the post at S. N. 2 shall initially be for a period of 03 months and may be extended for a further
03 month on need basis.
 The application form complete in all respects along with CV, self-attested copies of prescribed qualification certificates and
recent passport size photograph should reach the office of undersigned Department of Public Policy and Public
Administration, Central University of Jammu, Rahya-Suchani (Bagla), Samba–181143 (Jammu and Kashmir), either
as hard copy or by e-mail to Dr. Mohit Sharma at mohitcuj@gmail.com (CC to sushil.pppa@cujammu.ac.in (Dr. Sushil
Kamble) on or before 15th September, 2026 (by 11:59 PM). The application form can be downloaded from the University
website www.cujammu.ac.in.
 Shortlisted candidates for Interview will be intimated through email only. The Date for Interview is 17th September, 2026.
 The competent authority reserves the right to fill up or not to fill the vacancies notified in this advertisement.
 The preference will be given to those who have the experience of working in any research project.
Sd/-
Dr. Mohit Sharma
Project Co-ordinator
